MCP server (top of DAG; subprocesses the `alpha` CLI, composes nothing). Launch: `uv run alpha-mcp` (repo `.mcp.json` auto-launches it in Claude Code).
options & derivatives analytics. core only (+ numpy/scipy).

pure chart-pattern geometry over OHLCV bars: swing structure, triple taps, trendlines, wedges, head & shoulders, order blocks, FVGs, causal indicators/oscillators/cycles. **Depends only on `alpha_core`** (import-linter contract `alpha_patterns depends only on core`; numpy/polars allowed). It deliberately contains **no statistics** — it reports what it found and *when that was knowable*; evidence about whether a pattern "works" lives in `alpha_validation`/`alpha_research`. No app layer imports it yet (consumers are the unit + bias-guard tests); adding a CLI/MCP/web consumer follows the "Where do I add X?" rules and needs a new import-linter contract review. Every detector is bias-guarded (`tests/bias_guards/test_hs_no_lookahead.py`, `test_oscillator_no_lookahead.py`, `tests/unit/test_pattern_guards.py`).

pure deterministic Gate 1/D0 and D1 analysis-family primitives. core only; no network, persistence, credentials, broker, scheduler, or dynamic-code surface. The D2 confirmation primitives are consumed by the CLI's one-shot sealed executor (R6d, ADR-0026).
screener & news via finnhub (opt-in, API-key-gated). core only; the one network edge.
nautilus Strategy + pure decision fns. core only.
engine-agnostic stats primitives + tear sheet. core only (+ numpy/scipy; pandas/quantstats at the tearsheet edge).

the **ALPHA Workstation**: a thin JSON+SSE backend serving a built SPA (top of DAG; subprocesses CLI actions and status projections, composes nothing). Launch: `uv run alpha-web` → http://localhost:8801 (the socket remains loopback-only; the loopback-IP URL redirects to the canonical WebAuthn origin). Its platform imports are `alpha_core.config` plus supported public CLI seams for catalog/run-store, artifact contracts/projections, job capacity/durable leases, owner-auth verification, and the paper journal; bounded artifact reads may use Polars. Provider/system, control-plane, engine-backed, Qlib, and Kronos work stays behind CLI/out-of-process boundaries. The web process never imports or executes the engine, gauntlet, Nautilus, Qlib, or Kronos in-process.

Never: one-shot semantics, contamination handling, boundary commitments
